ui.foot: Kaliya sawirada yaryar ee YouTube ee dadweynaha. Xisaab ma jirto, soo dejinta fiidiyow ma jirto, raadinta URL-yada la dhejiyay ma jirto.
ui.heroTitle: Qofka soo saara sawirka yar ee YouTube
ui.heroIntro: Soo deji sawirada yaryar ee YouTube iyo isla markiiba tayada ugu sarreysa ee la heli karo, bilaash. Soo saar oo kaydi sawirada HD ee fiidiyow kasta oo YouTube dadweyne, Shorts, ama URL hal guji. Ku dheji xiriirka hoose, guji Hel sawirka yar, ka dib soo deji ama wadaag xiriir diyaar ah.
ui.INVALID_URL: Ku dheji URL YouTube ama dadweyne (sawirada yaryar ee TikTok/Instagram weli lama taageero).
ui.UNSUPPORTED_HOST: Hadda kaliya URL-yada YouTube iyo ee dadweynaha ayaa la taageeraa.
ui.INVALID_VIDEO_ID: Xiriirkaas laguma helin ID fiidiyow sax ah.
ui.THUMBNAIL_NOT_FOUND: Fiidiyowgan looma helin sawir yar oo dadweyne.
ui.NETWORK_ERROR: Khalad shabakadeed ayaa joojiyay raadinta. Isku day mar kale.
ui.TIMEOUT: Raadinta sawirka yar ayaa wakhtigeedii dhammaaday. Isku day mar kale.
ui.IMAGE_VALIDATION_FAILED: Sawirka yar lama xaqiijin karin inuu yahay sawir sax ah.
ui.DOWNLOAD_FAILED: Faylka lama soo dejin karin. Fur sawirka.
ui.CHANNEL_OR_PLAYLIST: Ku dheji URL-yada fiidiyowga, ma aha xiriirka kanaalka ama liiska.
